children: Public Policy Holding Company entered into five-year senior secured credit facilities totaling $105 million, comprising a $65 million term loan and a $40 million revolving facility, and borrowed $65 million at closing. The facilities can support debt refinancing, permitted acquisitions including Reevemark, working capital and other corporate needs; the company plans to seek additional commitments to raise the total to $150 million through a best-efforts syndication. In connection with the new agreement, the company repaid all amounts outstanding under and terminated its 2023 credit agreement with Bank of America.
: Senior secured term loan and revolving credit facilities
: Bank of America and participating lenders
: Refinance debt and fund acquisitions, working capital, and general corporate purposes
: Replace existing financing with new credit facilities
